sql.installAgreement.getFinancierFromProposa: WITH p AS ( SELECT proposal ->> 'Loan Type' AS loan_type FROM brs.proposal_log WHERE project_id = :projectId AND proposal_nbr = :proposalNbr ) SELECT substring(p.loan_type, 1, position(' ' IN p.loan_type) - 1) AS financier FROM p
sql.installAgreement.getUtilityFromProposalL: WITH p AS ( SELECT proposal ->> 'Utility Name' AS loan_type FROM brs.proposal_log WHERE project_id = :projectId AND proposal_nbr = :proposalNbr ) SELECT substring(p.loan_type, 1, position(' ' IN p.loan_type) - 1) AS utility_company FROM p
sql.installAgreement.setAgreementSent: UPDATE flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value SET timestamp_value = now() WHERE project_process_step_id = (select id from flow.project_process_step where project_id = :project_id and process_step_id = 4 and custom_field_group_assignment_id = 482)
sql.installAgreement.setRequestStatus: INSERT INTO brs.installation_agreement_requests ( project_id, proposal_nbr, send_installation_agreement, is_spanish, request_successful, user_id, created_date ) values ( :project_id, :proposal_nbr, :sendInstallationAgreement, :isSpanish, :success, :user_id, NOW())
sql.installAgreement.getProposalNumbers: select proposal_nbr from brs.proposal_log_history plh inner join flow.project p on p.id::text = plh.project_id::text where p.id = :projectId
sql.installAgreement.getLoanAmountFromLog: SELECT loan_amount from brs.proposal_log_history where project_id::integer = :projectId::integer and proposal_nbr::integer = :proposalNbr::integer
